decisions.reason: The two-component glass flake spraying system builds directly on the firm's core expertise in multi-component spray technology for heavy corrosion protection, so the firm can interpret field feedback well and keep refining it.

The low-pressure injection pump was field-tested on a construction site before launch and has its own page, showing that the firm has absorbed application learning in construction repair materials and intends to grow this line.
The low-pressure transfer pump line reuses the firm's proven air motors, so it sits squarely within existing knowledge and in-house manufacturing, giving low risk and high fit.

Fire protection flow monitoring lies further from the firm's core pump know-how, but it supports the firm's digitalization and monitoring goals and has a dedicated page, so the firm keeps it while it builds sensor and data competence.
The hydraulic two-component spraying system extends the firm's established two-component and hydraulic pump know-how, was launched only recently, and has strong absorptive fit.
